'''Lekk-Ji''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss commandos|commando]] living on [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was informed by an individual from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that his fellow commando [[Evoc-Ra]] died while escorting Voss scholars.<ref name="TOR" />
